## Introductions by Subham Pradhan

### About Me

Hi, I’m Subham Pradhan. I’m from India and study International Affairs. I enjoy trying
new things, exploring different cultures, and trying all kinds of sports. I love talking
with people and am always up for a conversation about history, politics, or our favourite
shows. I enjoy anime, K-dramas, Hollywood films, and Bollywood movies and series. Lately,
I’ve also been watching Chinese dramas and reading manga and manhwa. Naruto is my
favourite anime.

### My Team

#### Jimmy Yu

Jimmy is from China and is a junior at the University of Richmond in the United States,
where he studies Business. He enjoys tennis, pickleball, and video games. I love dancing
and going to parties with him. He also helps me with my Chinese studies. We often practise
conversations in Mandarin, which helps me prepare for my Mandarin exams. We enjoy going
to the movies and hanging out together, too.

#### Seymen Kizilkaya

Seymen is Turkish, lives in Germany, and studies economics in Switzerland. He is kind,
helpful, and always there for our group. He loves spending time with his friends and is
always ready to join in different activities and events. He also helps me learn more about
his culture. Seymen is one of the first people I’ve met who is truly passionate about
Bollywood: he loves Indian films, often hums Indian songs, and enjoys talking about
Indian movies. He also enjoys cooking, playing the piano, and football.
